issue_request: FHIR-33076 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to change ServiceRequest.bodySite from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(BodyStructure); the final motion instead kept bodySite at the time as 0..*, added ServiceRequest.bodyStructure as a 0..1 BodyStructure reference, required only one of bodySite/bodyStructure, and revised search parameters for both.
initial_application: The Jira application comment identifies f9fe7b872369abed6580eb173c609f6babf5baf1, which added ServiceRequest.bodyStructure as Reference(BodyStructure), adjusted the bodySite short label, and added a body-structure search parameter in build-scope ServiceRequest source.
additional_context: FHIR-50355 later clarified that ServiceRequest.bodyStructure was preferred over bodySite. FHIR-53203 is an Applied R6 OO decision that replaced non-Observation bodySite elements and search parameters with bodyStructure as CodeableReference(BodyStructure); ServiceRequest commits 696ac9113f1d1061e7fd4e4032043c744800f7a2 and 6be8ab5bc1bcae562ad5e2d663f46c7b23a9f72d converted bodyStructure to CodeableReference and removed the obsolete bodySite element/search parameter. FHIR-54843 is later Resolved - change required work to make ServiceRequest.bodyStructure 0..*, but it is not Applied/Published and was not applied as part of this seed audit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml has ServiceRequest.bodyStructure 0..1 CodeableReference targeting BodyStructure, and source/servicerequest/bundle-ServiceRequest-search-params.xml has bodyStructure reference and code search parameters with no remaining ServiceRequest.bodySite/body-site entry. Because bodySite no longer exists in ServiceRequest, the original mutual-exclusion invariant is obsolete.
